title: Rebuild the JSONL upsert
goal: Reading and writing files safely, and handling bad input without losing data.
spec:
Without AI help, write `upsertJsonl(text, rows)`:

- `text` is the current file, one JSON object per line.
- `rows` are objects with an `id`.
- Replace each row where its id first appears, append rows that are new, and drop older copies of an updated id.
- Keep every line you cannot parse, exactly as it was.

Then write `readJsonl(text)` that returns one row per id, using the **last** copy.
acceptance: An update replaces the row in place
Duplicate ids read as the last copy
hints: Split on "\n" and skip blank lines

title: Table-driven recency gate
goal: Writing a small pure function with boundary tests.
spec: Write `recencyGate(ageHours, score)` returning `apply`, `hold` or `skip` using the table in the "How Shortlist works" deck. Unknown age is `hold`; from 72 hours to 30 days it is `hold`; past 30 days it is `skip`. Then write a table-driven test that checks every boundary: 11.9, 12, 23.9, 24, 47.9, 48, 71.9, 72, 720 and 720.1 hours.
acceptance: No test depends on the current time

title: Debounced search box in React
goal: Effects, cleanup and race conditions in React.
spec: Build a search box that filters a list of 500 job titles. Wait 250 ms after the last keystroke before filtering, cancel a pending filter when a new key arrives, and never show results for an older query after a newer one.
acceptance: Results never flash an older query
hints: Return a cleanup function from the effect
Keep the query that produced the results next to them

title: Application funnel in SQL
goal: GROUP BY, joins and avoiding division by zero.
spec: Create tables `jobs(id, company, posted_at)` and `applications(id, job_id, status, applied_at)` in PostgreSQL. Write queries for: applications per status; response rate per company (any status past `applied` counts as a response); and the median days from posting to applying.
acceptance: Counts match a hand count on 10 rows
A company with no applications shows 0%, not an error
